feature: Explore variation through time: two recorded population comparison
behavior: Choose any two actual recorded generations and compare inherited trait distributions, means, ranges and recorded habitats.
Normalize each range share by its own population count and retain actual organism identities.
Visit real members and empty ranges on the island without changing the recorded expedition; keep the comparison pair fixed during visits.
Follow the selected organism to its recorded life story.
Save evidence to livingIslandPopulations without replacing student explanations, data notes or generation-cohort notes.
Preserve unfinished survival predictions when opening the comparison or visiting a range in the same generation; historical time travel retains the existing cancellation behavior.
Keep the optional comparison collapsed until opened and reveal it below sticky controls with the recorded island visible.

unitCoverage: Actual frame identities, metadata, trait means and extrema; reversed and same-generation comparisons.
Unequal population denominators and half-open range boundaries, including 0 and 1.
Identical means with different trait variation.
Valid zero traits and absent ranges versus undefined means and shares for empty populations.
Invalid frame and trait guards; unchanged world, genes and biological random stream.
populationComparisonJourneys: Real 3D desktop: recorded habitats despite queued future changes, fixed comparison pair, actual range members, keyboard selection, life story, separate journal entry, one renderer, unchanged host world and local cache.
Phone with reduced motion: empty ranges, real member navigation, visible entry below sticky tabs, no horizontal overflow, zero WCAG A/AA/2.1 AA violations in the component and focused island visits.
WebGL fallback extinction: valid zero-valued founder, undefined empty population mean and shares, real founder visits and truthful saved evidence.
validation.finalSafeguard: The desktop population-comparison journey was rerun after adding explicit assertions for retention of a drafted prediction.
validation.reviewedRenderSnapshotScope: Only the two evoLab digest entries were updated.
validation.recoveredTestFixtureIssue: Preloaded expeditions need not be written to the local world cache; tests now verify the host world and separately preserve the nullable local cache.

evidenceLimits: Two recorded distributions describe change without isolating a causal effect. Selection, chance, parent choice, inheritance and mutation can contribute. Individuals retain their genes throughout their lifetime. Higher trait values are not always better.
